chunks: Blessed is he who possesses a virtuous heart,

obeys one who guides him, keeps away from one who takes him to ruin, catches the path of safety with the help of him who provides him light (of guidance) and by obeying the leader who commands him, hastens towards guidance before its doors are closed, gets open the door of repentance and removes the (stain of) sins. He has certainly been put on the right path and guided towards the straight road.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of a person with a virtuous heart according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) defines the 'sound heart' (qalb salim) not merely as an internal state but as one validated by practical obedience to divine guides and timely repentance. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the interplay between inner purity and external adherence to the path of the Ahl al-Bayt, ensuring one does not miss the window of opportunity for salvation before the 'doors of guidance' close.
